     #include <dsps_dotprod.h>
     #include <esp_heap_caps.h>
     
     // Aligned allocation for embeddings
     _embeddings = (float*)heap_caps_aligned_alloc(16, embedSize, MALLOC_CAP_SPIRAM);
     
     // SIMD cosine similarity
     float EmbeddingSearch::_cosineSimilarity(const float* a, const float* b) {
         float dot = 0.0f, normA = 0.0f, normB = 0.0f;
         dsps_dotprod_f32_aes3(a, b, &dot, AUDIO_EMBEDDING_DIM);
         dsps_dotprod_f32_aes3(a, a, &normA, AUDIO_EMBEDDING_DIM);
         dsps_dotprod_f32_aes3(b, b, &normB, AUDIO_EMBEDDING_DIM);
         float denom = sqrtf(normA) * sqrtf(normB);
         return (denom > 1e-8f) ? dot / denom : 0.0f;
     }
     
     // Top-5 debug output in search()
     Serial.println("=== TOP 5 MATCHES ===");

         Serial.printf("  #%d: %.4f - \"%s\"\n", i + 1, topScores[i], intentBuf);
     }

     // Aligned mel filterbank

     // SIMD mel filterbank application
     void AudioEmbedder::_applyMelFilterbank(float* powerSpectrum, float* melOutput) {
         for (int m = 0; m < AUDIO_MEL_BINS; m++) {
             float sum = 0.0f;
             dsps_dotprod_f32_aes3(&_melFilterbank[m * numFreqBins],
                                   powerSpectrum, &sum, numFreqBins);
             melOutput[m] = log10f(sum + 1e-10f);
         }
     }

   124→    runtimeConfig.idleSleepMs = doc["idle_sleep_ms"] | IDLE_SLEEP_MS;
   125→    runtimeConfig.recordDurationMs = doc["record_duration_ms"] | RECORD_DURATION_MS;
   126→
   127→    Serial.println("Config: Loaded from SD card");
   128→    Serial.printf("  embed_threshold: %.2f\n", runtimeConfig.embedThreshold);
   129→    Serial.printf("  llm_temperature: %.2f\n", runtimeConfig.llmTemperature);
   130→    Serial.printf("  llm_max_tokens: %d\n", runtimeConfig.llmMaxTokens);
   131→
   132→    return true;
   133→}

   135→//==============================================================================
   136→// LLM Token Callback (Phase 4)
   137→//==============================================================================
   138→
   139→void onLLMToken(const char* token, void* userData) {
   140→    // Append token to response buffer and display
   141→    llmResponse += token;
   142→    video.appendText(token);
   143→    Serial.print(token);  // Also print to serial for debugging
   144→}
   145→
   146→//==============================================================================
   147→// State Machine Helpers
   148→//==============================================================================
   149→
   150→void setState(BadgeState newState) {
   151→    if (currentState == newState) return;
   152→
   153→    Serial.printf("State: %d -> %d\n", currentState, newState);
   154→
   155→    // Exit current state
   156→    switch (currentState) {
   157→        case STATE_LOGO_LOOP:
   158→            // Stop wake word detection and mic stream
   159→            if (wakeWordActive) {
   160→                wakeWord.end();
   161→                micStream.end();
   162→                wakeWordActive = false;
   163→            }
   164→            break;
   165→        case STATE_DISPLAY_RESPONSE:
   166→            video.hideText();
   167→            break;
   168→        case STATE_RECORDING:
   169→            recorder.stopRecording();
   170→            break;
   171→        default:
   172→            break;
   173→    }
   174→
   175→    currentState = newState;
   176→    lastActivityTime = millis();
   177→
   178→    // Enter new state
   179→    switch (newState) {
   180→        case STATE_LOGO_LOOP:
   181→            video.resume();
   182→            // Start wake word detection
   183→            if (mlPool) {
   184→                if (micStream.begin()) {
   185→                    if (wakeWord.begin(mlPool, ML_POOL_SIZE, WAKE_MODEL_PATH, WAKE_CONFIG_PATH)) {
   186→                        wakeWordActive = true;
   187→                        Serial.printf("Listening for \"%s\"...\n", wakeWord.getWakeWord());
   188→                        // Refresh display after SD card access (wake word model loading)
   189→                        video.refreshDisplay();
   190→                    } else {
   191→                        Serial.println("Wake word init failed");
   192→                        micStream.end();
   193→                    }
   194→                } else {
   195→                    Serial.println("Mic stream init failed");
   196→                }
   197→            }
   198→            break;
   199→        case STATE_RECORDING:
   200→            // Pause video during recording
   201→            video.pause();
   202→            recorder.startRecording(runtimeConfig.recordDurationMs / 1000.0f);
   203→            break;
   204→        case STATE_DISPLAY_RESPONSE:
   205→            // Keep logo playing - response already spoken via TTS
   206→            video.resume();
   207→            video.hideText();
   208→            break;
   209→        case STATE_EMBEDDING:
   210→            // Keep video paused during processing (no text - looks cleaner)
   211→            video.pause();
   212→            video.hideText();
   213→            printPSRAM("before audio encoder");
   214→            // Load audio encoder model
   215→            if (!audioEmbed.begin(mlPool, ML_POOL_SIZE, AUDIO_ENCODER_PATH)) {
   216→                Serial.println("Audio encoder init failed - returning to logo");
   217→                setState(STATE_TTS_SORRY);
   218→            } else {
   219→                printPSRAM("after audio encoder");
   220→            }
   221→            break;
   222→        case STATE_SIMILARITY:
   223→            // Audio encoder unloaded, search against embeddings
   224→            audioEmbed.end();
   225→            // Keep video paused (no text)
   226→            break;
   227→        case STATE_TTS_SORRY:
   228→            // Keep logo playing - just speak the apology, no text needed
   229→            video.resume();
   230→            video.hideText();
   231→            ttsSpeaking = true;
   232→            break;
   233→        case STATE_TTS_OUTPUT:
   234→            // Pause video to show LLM response text
   235→            video.pause();
   236→            video.refreshDisplay();
   237→            video.fillScreen(0x0000);  // BLACK background for text
   238→            if (llmResponse.length() > 0) {
   239→                video.showText(llmResponse.c_str());
   240→            }
   241→            ttsSpeaking = true;
   242→            break;
   243→        case STATE_LLM_INFERENCE:
   244→            // Pause video to show streaming LLM text
   245→            video.pause();
   246→            video.refreshDisplay();
   247→            video.fillScreen(0x0000);  // BLACK background for text
   248→            video.clearText();
   249→            video.showText("");  // Initialize empty text box
   250→            llmResponse = "";
   251→            llmGenerating = true;
   252→
   253→            // CRITICAL: Unload embeddings to free ~2MB PSRAM for LLM model
   254→            // The search result is already saved in lastSearchResult.intent
   255→            Serial.println("Unloading embeddings to make room for LLM...");
   256→            embedSearch.end();
   257→            printPSRAM("after embed unload");
   258→
   259→            // Load LLM model
   260→            Serial.println("Loading LLM model...");
   261→            if (!llmInference.begin(mlPool, ML_POOL_SIZE, LLM_MODEL_PATH, TOKENIZER_PATH)) {
   262→                Serial.println("LLM init failed - showing intent only");
   263→                video.showText(lastSearchResult.intent);
   264→                llmGenerating = false;
   265→                // Reload embeddings since LLM failed
   266→                embedSearch.begin(EMBEDDINGS_PATH, INTENTS_PATH);
   267→                setState(STATE_DISPLAY_RESPONSE);
   268→            } else {
   269→                // Apply runtime config
   270→                llmInference.setTemperature(runtimeConfig.llmTemperature);
   271→                llmInference.setTopP(runtimeConfig.llmTopP);
   272→                llmInference.setMaxTokens(runtimeConfig.llmMaxTokens);
   273→            }
   274→            break;
   275→        default:
   276→            break;
   277→    }
   278→}
   279→
   280→void resetActivityTimer() {
   281→    lastActivityTime = millis();
   282→}
   283→
   284→//==============================================================================
   285→// State Handlers
   286→//==============================================================================
   287→
   288→void handleLogoLoop() {
   289→    // Update orientation
   290→    orientation.update();
   291→    if (orientation.hasChanged()) {
   292→        video.setRotation(orientation.getRotation());
   293→    }
   294→
   295→    // Play video frame
   296→    video.play();
   297→
   298→    // Check wake word if active
   299→    if (wakeWordActive) {
   300→        if (micStream.update()) {
   301→            // New features available, run wake word detection
   302→            if (wakeWord.detect(micStream.getFeatures())) {
   303→                Serial.println(">>> WAKE WORD DETECTED! <<<");
   304→                setState(STATE_RECORDING);
   305→            }
   306→        }
   307→    }
   308→}
   309→
   310→// Counter for recording filenames
   311→static int recordingCounter = 0;
   312→
   313→void handleRecording() {
   314→    // Update recording (video paused)
   315→    if (recorder.update()) {
   316→        // Recording complete
   317→        Serial.printf("Recording done: %d samples (%.2fs)\n",
   318→                      recorder.getSampleCount(), recorder.getDurationSec());
   319→
   320→        // Save recording to SD card for debugging
   321→        char filepath[64];
   322→        snprintf(filepath, sizeof(filepath), "/recordings/rec_%04d.wav", recordingCounter++);
   323→
   324→        // Create recordings directory if needed
   325→        if (!SD.exists("/recordings")) {
   326→            SD.mkdir("/recordings");
   327→        }
   328→        recorder.saveToSD(filepath);
   329→
   330→        // Phase 3: Extract embedding from recording
   331→        setState(STATE_EMBEDDING);
   332→    }
   333→}
   334→
   335→void handleEmbedding() {
   336→    // Run audio embedding extraction (blocking operation)
   337→    if (audioEmbed.embed(recorder.getBuffer(), recorder.getSampleCount(), queryEmbedding)) {
   338→        Serial.println("Embedding extracted successfully");
   339→        setState(STATE_SIMILARITY);
   340→    } else {
   341→        Serial.println("Embedding extraction failed");
   342→        setState(STATE_TTS_SORRY);
   343→    }
   344→}
   345→
   346→void handleSimilarity() {
   347→    // Search for closest embedding
   348→    lastSearchResult = embedSearch.search(queryEmbedding);
   349→
   350→    Serial.printf("Best match: %s (score: %.3f)\n",
   351→                  lastSearchResult.intent, lastSearchResult.score);
   352→
   353→    if (lastSearchResult.score >= runtimeConfig.embedThreshold) {
   354→        // Good match - run LLM inference
   355→        Serial.println("High confidence match!");
   356→        setState(STATE_LLM_INFERENCE);
   357→    } else {
   358→        // Low confidence - stash and apologize
   359→        Serial.println("Low confidence - stashing");
   360→        // TODO Phase 8: stash audio and embedding
   361→        setState(STATE_TTS_SORRY);
   362→    }
   363→}
   364→
   365→void handleLLMInference() {
   366→    if (!llmGenerating) {
   367→        // Generation done - shouldn't normally get here as we transition immediately
   368→        setState(STATE_TTS_OUTPUT);
   369→        return;
   370→    }
   371→
   372→    // Run LLM generation (blocking, but streams tokens via callback)
   373→    Serial.printf("\nLLM generating response for: %s\n", lastSearchResult.intent);
   374→    int tokensGenerated = llmInference.generate(lastSearchResult.intent, onLLMToken, nullptr);
   375→    Serial.printf("\nLLM done: %d tokens\n", tokensGenerated);
   376→
   377→    llmGenerating = false;
   378→
   379→    // Unload LLM to free memory
   380→    llmInference.end();
   381→    printPSRAM("after LLM unload");
   382→
   383→    // Reload embeddings now that LLM is unloaded
   384→    Serial.println("Reloading embeddings...");
   385→    if (!embedSearch.begin(EMBEDDINGS_PATH, INTENTS_PATH)) {
   386→        Serial.println("WARNING: Failed to reload embeddings!");
   387→    }
   388→    printPSRAM("after embed reload");
   389→
   390→    // If no tokens generated, use the intent as fallback
   391→    if (tokensGenerated == 0 && llmResponse.length() == 0) {
   392→        llmResponse = lastSearchResult.intent;
   393→    }
   394→
   395→    // Transition to TTS to speak the response
   396→    setState(STATE_TTS_OUTPUT);
   397→}
   398→
   399→void handleDisplayResponse() {
   400→    // Auto-return to logo loop after 3 seconds
   401→    if (millis() - lastActivityTime > 3000) {
   402→        setState(STATE_LOGO_LOOP);
   403→    }
   404→}
   405→
   406→void handleTtsSorry() {
   407→    if (ttsSpeaking) {
   408→        // Speak apology (blocking)
   409→        tts.speak("Sorry, I could not understand that.");
   410→        ttsSpeaking = false;
   411→        lastActivityTime = millis();
   412→    }
   413→
   414→    // Wait a bit after speaking, then return to logo
   415→    if (millis() - lastActivityTime > 1000) {
   416→        setState(STATE_LOGO_LOOP);
   417→    }
   418→}
   419→
   420→void handleTtsOutput() {
   421→    if (ttsSpeaking) {
   422→        // Speak the LLM response (blocking)
   423→        if (llmResponse.length() > 0) {
   424→            tts.speak(llmResponse.c_str());
   425→        }
   426→        ttsSpeaking = false;
   427→        lastActivityTime = millis();
   428→    }
   429→
   430→    // Wait a bit after speaking, then return to logo
   431→    if (millis() - lastActivityTime > 1000) {
   432→        setState(STATE_LOGO_LOOP);
   433→    }
   434→}
   435→
   436→//==============================================================================
   437→// Main Loop State Machine
   438→//==============================================================================
   439→
   440→void loop() {
   441→    // State-specific handling
   442→    switch (currentState) {
   443→        case STATE_BOOT:
   444→            // Initialization complete, transition to logo loop
   445→            setState(STATE_LOGO_LOOP);
   446→            break;
   447→
   448→        case STATE_LOGO_LOOP:
   449→            handleLogoLoop();
   450→            break;
   451→
   452→        case STATE_RECORDING:
   453→            handleRecording();
   454→            break;
   455→
   456→        case STATE_DISPLAY_RESPONSE:
   457→            handleDisplayResponse();
   458→            break;
   459→
   460→        case STATE_EMBEDDING:
   461→            handleEmbedding();
   462→            break;
   463→
   464→        case STATE_SIMILARITY:
   465→            handleSimilarity();
   466→            break;
   467→
   468→        case STATE_TTS_SORRY:
   469→            handleTtsSorry();
   470→            break;
   471→
   472→        case STATE_LLM_INFERENCE:
   473→            handleLLMInference();
   474→            break;
   475→
   476→        case STATE_TTS_OUTPUT:
   477→            handleTtsOutput();
   478→            break;
   479→
   480→        // Future states (Phase 6+)
   481→        case STATE_STASH_DATA:
   482→        case STATE_DEEP_SLEEP:
   483→            // Not implemented yet - return to logo
   484→            setState(STATE_LOGO_LOOP);
   485→            break;
   486→    }
   487→}

   493→void printPSRAM(const char* label) {
   494→    Serial.printf("PSRAM [%s]: %dKB free / %dKB total\n",

   500→//==============================================================================
   501→// Setup
   502→//==============================================================================
   503→
   504→void setup() {
   505→    Serial.begin(115200);
   506→    delay(500);
   507→    Serial.println("\n=== OAISYS25 Badge Starting ===");
   508→    printPSRAM("boot");
   509→
   510→    // Initialize orientation sensor (non-fatal if fails)
   511→    if (!orientation.begin()) {
   512→        Serial.println("IMU init failed - rotation disabled");
   513→    } else {
   514→        Serial.println("IMU: OK");
   515→    }
   516→
   517→    // Initialize video player FIRST (this also inits display and SD card)
   518→    // Must be before ML pool to avoid PSRAM fragmentation
   519→    Serial.println("Loading video...");
   520→    if (!video.begin()) {
   521→        Serial.println("ERROR: Video init failed!");
   522→        // Blink LED to indicate error
   523→        pinMode(LCD_BL, OUTPUT);
   524→        while (1) {
   525→            digitalWrite(LCD_BL, !digitalRead(LCD_BL));
   526→            delay(500);
   527→        }
   528→    }
   529→    Serial.println("Video: OK");
   530→    printPSRAM("after video");
   531→
   532→    // Load runtime configuration from SD card
   533→    loadConfig();
   534→
   535→    // Initialize audio recorder (allocates PSRAM buffer)
   536→    if (!recorder.begin()) {
   537→        Serial.println("WARNING: Audio recorder init failed!");
   538→    } else {
   539→        Serial.println("Recorder: OK");
   540→    }
   541→    printPSRAM("after recorder");
   542→
   543→    // Phase 3: Allocate query embedding buffer (16-byte aligned for ESP-DSP SIMD)
   544→    queryEmbedding = (float*)heap_caps_aligned_alloc(16,
   545→        AUDIO_EMBEDDING_DIM * sizeof(float), MALLOC_CAP_SPIRAM);
   546→    if (!queryEmbedding) {
   547→        Serial.println("WARNING: Query embedding buffer alloc failed!");
   548→    } else {
   549→        Serial.println("Query buffer: OK (aligned)");
   550→    }
   551→
   552→    // Phase 3: Load embedding search database (stays in memory)
   553→    // IMPORTANT: Load embeddings BEFORE ML pool - they stay resident permanently
   554→    if (!embedSearch.begin(EMBEDDINGS_PATH, INTENTS_PATH)) {
   555→        Serial.println("WARNING: Embedding search init failed!");
   556→        Serial.println("  Make sure SD card has /data/embeddings.bin and /data/intents.txt");
   557→    } else {
   558→        Serial.printf("EmbedSearch: %d intents loaded\n", embedSearch.getCount());
   559→    }
   560→    printPSRAM("after embeddings");
   561→
   562→    // Allocate ML memory pool (after embeddings to ensure they get contiguous memory)
   563→    // Remaining PSRAM is used for ML models that load/unload dynamically
   564→    if (!initMemoryPool()) {
   565→        Serial.println("WARNING: ML features disabled (no pool)");
   566→    }
   567→    printPSRAM("after ML pool");
   568→
   569→    // Phase 5: Initialize TTS (non-fatal if fails)
   570→    if (!tts.begin()) {
   571→        Serial.println("WARNING: TTS init failed - speech disabled");
   572→    } else {
   573→        Serial.println("TTS: OK (SAM robotic voice)");
   574→        // Say hello on startup
   575→        tts.speak("Hello. I am ready.");
   576→    }
   577→
   578→    // Ready to go
   579→    lastActivityTime = millis();
   580→    currentState = STATE_BOOT;
   581→
   582→    Serial.println("\n=== Badge Ready (Phase 5) ===");
   583→    printPSRAM("final");
   584→    Serial.println("Say 'Hey Daisy' to start recording");
   585→    Serial.println("Recording -> Embedding -> Similarity -> LLM -> TTS");
   586→}

   145→void AudioRecorder::_warmUpMic() {
   146→    // INMP441 needs ~100-200ms minimum to stabilize, but for best results
   147→    // we discard 2 full seconds of audio data
   148→    // At 16kHz, that's 32000 samples = 128KB of data to discard
   149→
   150→    const int WARMUP_SAMPLES = RECORDING_SAMPLE_RATE * 2;  // 2 seconds
   151→    int samplesDiscarded = 0;
   152→    size_t bytes_read;
   153→
   154→    unsigned long startTime = millis();
   155→
   156→    while (samplesDiscarded < WARMUP_SAMPLES) {
   157→        // Read and discard
   158→        if (i2s_read(I2S_NUM_0, _i2sBuffer, 512 * 4, &bytes_read, 10) == ESP_OK) {
   159→            samplesDiscarded += bytes_read / 4;
   160→        }
   161→    }
   162→
   163→    Serial.printf("AudioRecorder: Warm-up done (%d ms, %d samples discarded)\n",
   164→                  (int)(millis() - startTime), samplesDiscarded);
   165→}

   144→bool MicStream::_captureAudio() {
   145→    int space_available = AUDIO_BUFFER_SIZE - _audioBufferPos;
   146→    if (space_available < 256) {
   147→        return true;  // Buffer full, will process
   148→    }
   149→
   150→    int samples_to_read = min(256, space_available);
   151→    size_t bytes_read;
   152→    if (i2s_read(I2S_NUM_0, _i2sBuffer, samples_to_read * 4, &bytes_read, 10) != ESP_OK) {
   153→        return false;
   154→    }
   155→
   156→    int samples = bytes_read / 4;
   157→    int32_t max_sample = 0;
   158→
   159→    for (int i = 0; i < samples; i++) {
   160→        // INMP441 sends 24-bit in 32-bit frame, shift down
   161→        int32_t sample = _i2sBuffer[i] >> 14;
   162→        _audioBuffer[_audioBufferPos++] = constrain(sample, -32768, 32767);
   163→        if (abs(sample) > max_sample) max_sample = abs(sample);
   164→    }
   165→
   166→    _amplitude = max_sample;
   167→    return true;
   168→}
   169→
   170→bool MicStream::update() {
   171→    if (!_running) return false;
   172→
   173→    if (!_captureAudio()) {
   174→        return false;
   175→    }
   176→
   177→    bool newFrame = false;
   178→
   179→    // Process audio through frontend when we have enough samples
   180→    while (_audioBufferPos >= FEATURE_STRIDE_SAMPLES) {
   181→        size_t num_samples_read;
   182→        FrontendOutput frontend_output = FrontendProcessSamples(
   183→            _frontendState, _audioBuffer, _audioBufferPos, &num_samples_read);
   184→
   185→        if (num_samples_read == 0) {
   186→            break;
   187→        }
   188→
   189→        // Shift remaining samples to start of buffer
   190→        if (num_samples_read < (size_t)_audioBufferPos) {
   191→            memmove(_audioBuffer, _audioBuffer + num_samples_read,
   192→                    (_audioBufferPos - num_samples_read) * sizeof(int16_t));
   193→        }
   194→        _audioBufferPos -= num_samples_read;
   195→
   196→        // If we got features, add to feature buffer
   197→        if (frontend_output.size == FEATURE_BINS) {
   198→            // Shift feature frames if buffer is full
   199→            if (_featureFrameCount >= FEATURE_FRAMES) {
   200→                memmove(_featureBuffer, _featureBuffer + FEATURE_BINS,
   201→                        (FEATURE_FRAMES - 1) * FEATURE_BINS * sizeof(uint16_t));
   202→                _featureFrameCount = FEATURE_FRAMES - 1;
   203→            }
   204→
   205→            // Add new frame
   206→            memcpy(_featureBuffer + _featureFrameCount * FEATURE_BINS,
   207→                   frontend_output.values, FEATURE_BINS * sizeof(uint16_t));
   208→            _featureFrameCount++;
   209→
   210→            // Signal that we have a complete feature set
   211→            if (_featureFrameCount >= FEATURE_FRAMES) {
   212→                newFrame = true;
   213→            }
   214→        }
   215→    }
   216→
   217→    return newFrame;
   218→}

   220→int MicStream::getNewSamples(int16_t* buffer, size_t maxSamples) {
   221→    // This provides raw audio for recording purposes
   222→    // For now, return what's in buffer (caller should copy before next update)
   223→    int count = min((size_t)_audioBufferPos, maxSamples);
   224→    if (count > 0 && buffer) {
   225→        memcpy(buffer, _audioBuffer, count * sizeof(int16_t));
   226→    }
   227→    return count;
   228→}

Added 2-second warm-up period in both:
- `audio_recorder.cpp:_warmUpMic()` - for recording after wake word
- `mic_stream.cpp:_warmUpMic()` - for wake word detection on startup

This discards the first 32,000 samples (~2 seconds) after I2S init, allowing the INMP441 microphone to stabilize before actual audio capture begins.

The recordings saved to `/recordings/` should now have clean audio from the start instead of 2 seconds of junk.

- STATE_LOGO_LOOP: wake word is active
- Wake word detected → STATE_RECORDING
- Recording done → STATE_EMBEDDING

The core problem involves TFLite's memory management within the MicroAllocator. When switching between models, the interpreter's memory pool isn't being fully released, causing allocation conflicts. Specifically, the wake word interpreter's memory remains partially allocated when attempting to initialize the audio encoder, leading to a resource contention issue in the static memory resolver.

The sequence reveals a critical synchronization problem: despite calling end() on the wake word module, the underlying TFLite MicroAllocator retains internal state preventing clean pool reuse. This suggests a need for more explicit memory teardown between model transitions to ensure complete resource liberation.

   217→float WakeWordDetector::_runInference(const uint16_t* features) {
   218→    int total_features = FEATURE_FRAMES * FEATURE_BINS;
   219→
   220→    // Quantize features to input tensor format
   221→    if (_inputTensor->type == kTfLiteInt8) {
   222→        int8_t* input_data = _inputTensor->data.int8;
   223→        for (int i = 0; i < total_features; i++) {
   224→            int32_t scaled = ((int32_t)features[i] * 256 + 333) / 666 - 128;
   225→            input_data[i] = constrain(scaled, -128, 127);
   226→        }
   227→    } else {
   228→        // Float input
   229→        float* input_data = _inputTensor->data.f;
   230→        for (int i = 0; i < total_features; i++) {
   231→            input_data[i] = features[i] / 25.6f;
   232→        }
   233→    }
   234→
   235→    // Run inference
   236→    if (_interpreter->Invoke() != kTfLiteOk) {
   237→        return 0.0f;
   238→    }
   239→
   240→    // Dequantize output
   241→    float probability;
   242→    if (_outputTensor->type == kTfLiteUInt8) {
   243→        uint8_t output_value = _outputTensor->data.uint8[0];
   244→        probability = (output_value - _outputTensor->params.zero_point) *
   245→                      _outputTensor->params.scale;
   246→    } else if (_outputTensor->type == kTfLiteInt8) {
   247→        int8_t output_value = _outputTensor->data.int8[0];
   248→        probability = (output_value - _outputTensor->params.zero_point) *
   249→                      _outputTensor->params.scale;
   250→    } else {
   251→        probability = _outputTensor->data.f[0];
   252→    }
   253→
   254→    return probability;
   255→}
   256→
   257→bool WakeWordDetector::detect(const uint16_t* features) {
   258→    if (!_loaded) return false;
   259→
   260→    // Run inference
   261→    float prob = _runInference(features);
   262→    _lastProbability = prob;
   263→
   264→    // Update sliding window
   265→    _probabilityWindow[_windowPos] = prob;
   266→    _windowPos = (_windowPos + 1) % _config.sliding_window_size;
   267→
   268→    if (_windowPos == 0) {
   269→        _windowFilled = true;
   270→    }
   271→
   272→    // Need full window before detection
   273→    if (!_windowFilled) {
   274→        return false;
   275→    }
   276→
   277→    // Check cooldown
   278→    if (millis() - _lastDetectionMs < (unsigned long)_config.cooldown_ms) {
   279→        return false;
   280→    }
   281→
   282→    // Calculate average and count high frames
   283→    float avg = 0.0f;
   284→    int high_frames = 0;
   285→    for (int i = 0; i < _config.sliding_window_size; i++) {
   286→        avg += _probabilityWindow[i];
   287→        if (_probabilityWindow[i] >= _config.min_frame_prob) {
   288→            high_frames++;
   289→        }
   290→    }
   291→    avg /= _config.sliding_window_size;
   292→
   293→    // Detection criteria
   294→    if (avg >= _config.probability_cutoff && high_frames >= _config.min_high_frames) {
   295→        _lastDetectionMs = millis();
   296→        _resetWindow();
   297→        return true;
   298→    }
   299→
   300→    return false;
   301→}

    90→        free(_modelData);
    91→        _modelData = nullptr;
    92→    }
    93→
    94→    _endMelSpectrogram();
    95→    _loaded = false;
    96→}

    98→//==============================================================================
    99→// Mel-Spectrogram Implementation
   100→//==============================================================================
   101→
   102→bool AudioEmbedder::_initMelSpectrogram() {
   103→    int numFreqBins = AUDIO_FFT_SIZE / 2 + 1;
   104→
   105→    // Allocate mel filterbank (16-byte aligned for ESP-DSP SIMD)
   106→    size_t filterSize = AUDIO_MEL_BINS * numFreqBins * sizeof(float);
   107→    _melFilterbank = (float*)heap_caps_aligned_alloc(16, filterSize, MALLOC_CAP_SPIRAM);
   108→    if (!_melFilterbank) return false;
   109→
   110→    // Allocate working buffers
   111→    _fftInput = (float*)ps_malloc(AUDIO_FFT_SIZE * sizeof(float));
   112→    _fftOutput = (float*)ps_malloc(AUDIO_FFT_SIZE * 2 * sizeof(float));
   113→    _window = (float*)ps_malloc(AUDIO_FFT_SIZE * sizeof(float));
   114→    _melFeatures = (float*)ps_malloc(AUDIO_MEL_BINS * AUDIO_MEL_FRAMES * sizeof(float));
   115→
   116→    if (!_fftInput || !_fftOutput || !_window || !_melFeatures) {
   117→        _endMelSpectrogram();
   118→        return false;
   119→    }
   120→
   121→    // Initialize ESP-DSP FFT
   122→    esp_err_t ret = dsps_fft2r_init_fc32(NULL, AUDIO_FFT_SIZE);
   123→    if (ret != ESP_OK) {
   124→        _endMelSpectrogram();
   125→        return false;
   126→    }
   127→
   128→    // Create Hann window
   129→    for (int i = 0; i < AUDIO_FFT_SIZE; i++) {
   130→        _window[i] = 0.5f * (1.0f - cosf(2.0f * M_PI * i / (AUDIO_FFT_SIZE - 1)));
   131→    }
   132→
   133→    // Initialize mel filterbank
   134→    float minFreq = 125.0f;
   135→    float maxFreq = 7500.0f;
   136→    float minMel = _hzToMel(minFreq);
   137→    float maxMel = _hzToMel(maxFreq);
   138→
   139→    // Create mel filter centers
   140→    float* melCenters = (float*)malloc((AUDIO_MEL_BINS + 2) * sizeof(float));
   141→    for (int i = 0; i < AUDIO_MEL_BINS + 2; i++) {
   142→        float mel = minMel + (maxMel - minMel) * i / (AUDIO_MEL_BINS + 1);
   143→        melCenters[i] = _melToHz(mel);
   144→    }
   145→
   146→    // Build triangular filters
   147→    float freqRes = (float)AUDIO_SAMPLE_RATE / AUDIO_FFT_SIZE;
   148→
   149→    for (int m = 0; m < AUDIO_MEL_BINS; m++) {
   150→        float left = melCenters[m];
   151→        float center = melCenters[m + 1];
   152→        float right = melCenters[m + 2];
   153→
   154→        for (int k = 0; k < numFreqBins; k++) {
   155→            float freq = k * freqRes;
   156→            float weight = 0.0f;
   157→
   158→            if (freq >= left && freq <= center) {
   159→                weight = (freq - left) / (center - left);
   160→            } else if (freq > center && freq <= right) {
   161→                weight = (right - freq) / (right - center);
   162→            }
   163→
   164→            _melFilterbank[m * numFreqBins + k] = weight;
   165→        }
   166→    }
   167→
   168→    free(melCenters);
   169→    _melInitialized = true;
   170→    return true;
   171→}
   172→
   173→void AudioEmbedder::_endMelSpectrogram() {
   174→    if (_melFilterbank) { free(_melFilterbank); _melFilterbank = nullptr; }
   175→    if (_fftInput) { free(_fftInput); _fftInput = nullptr; }
   176→    if (_fftOutput) { free(_fftOutput); _fftOutput = nullptr; }
   177→    if (_window) { free(_window); _window = nullptr; }
   178→    if (_melFeatures) { free(_melFeatures); _melFeatures = nullptr; }
   179→    _melInitialized = false;
   180→}
   181→
   182→bool AudioEmbedder::_computeMelSpectrogram(const int16_t* audio, size_t samples, float* melOutput) {
   183→    if (!_melInitialized) return false;
   184→
   185→    float globalMin = 1e10f;
   186→    float globalMax = -1e10f;
   187→
   188→    // Generate frames - output format: (bins, frames) = (64, 96)
   189→    for (int frame = 0; frame < AUDIO_MEL_FRAMES; frame++) {
   190→        int startIdx = frame * AUDIO_HOP_LENGTH;
   191→
   192→        if (startIdx + AUDIO_FFT_SIZE > (int)samples) {
   193→            // Zero-pad remaining frames
   194→            for (int i = 0; i < AUDIO_MEL_BINS; i++) {
   195→                melOutput[i * AUDIO_MEL_FRAMES + frame] = -80.0f;
   196→            }
   197→            continue;
   198→        }
   199→
   200→        // Compute power spectrum
   201→        float powerSpectrum[AUDIO_FFT_SIZE / 2 + 1];
   202→        _computeFFTFrame(audio, startIdx, powerSpectrum);
   203→
   204→        // Apply mel filterbank
   205→        float melFrame[AUDIO_MEL_BINS];
   206→        _applyMelFilterbank(powerSpectrum, melFrame);
   207→
   208→        // Store in (bins, frames) format for CNN input
   209→        for (int i = 0; i < AUDIO_MEL_BINS; i++) {
   210→            melOutput[i * AUDIO_MEL_FRAMES + frame] = melFrame[i];
   211→            if (melFrame[i] < globalMin) globalMin = melFrame[i];
   212→            if (melFrame[i] > globalMax) globalMax = melFrame[i];
   213→        }
   214→    }
   215→
   216→    // Debug: Print mel-spectrogram stats BEFORE normalization
   217→    Serial.printf("AudioEmbed: Mel-spec raw: min=%.2f, max=%.2f, range=%.2f\n",
   218→                  globalMin, globalMax, globalMax - globalMin);
   219→
   220→    // Normalize to [0, 1] range (like training)
   221→    float range = globalMax - globalMin;
   222→    if (range > 1e-8f) {
   223→        for (int i = 0; i < AUDIO_MEL_BINS * AUDIO_MEL_FRAMES; i++) {
   224→            melOutput[i] = (melOutput[i] - globalMin) / range;
   225→        }
   226→    }
   227→
   228→    // Debug: Print a few values after normalization
   229→    Serial.printf("AudioEmbed: Mel-spec normalized sample: [%.3f, %.3f, %.3f, %.3f]\n",
   230→                  melOutput[0], melOutput[AUDIO_MEL_FRAMES],
   231→                  melOutput[2*AUDIO_MEL_FRAMES], melOutput[3*AUDIO_MEL_FRAMES]);
   232→
   233→    return true;
   234→}
   235→
   236→void AudioEmbedder::_computeFFTFrame(const int16_t* audio, int startIdx, float* powerSpectrum) {
   237→    // Apply window and convert to float
   238→    for (int i = 0; i < AUDIO_FFT_SIZE; i++) {
   239→        _fftInput[i] = (float)audio[startIdx + i] * _window[i] / 32768.0f;
   240→    }
   241→
   242→    // Prepare complex input (real part only)
   243→    for (int i = 0; i < AUDIO_FFT_SIZE; i++) {
   244→        _fftOutput[i * 2] = _fftInput[i];
   245→        _fftOutput[i * 2 + 1] = 0.0f;
   246→    }
   247→
   248→    // Compute FFT using ESP-DSP
   249→    dsps_fft2r_fc32(_fftOutput, AUDIO_FFT_SIZE);
   250→    dsps_bit_rev_fc32(_fftOutput, AUDIO_FFT_SIZE);
   251→
   252→    // Compute power spectrum: |X[k]|^2
   253→    for (int k = 0; k < AUDIO_FFT_SIZE / 2 + 1; k++) {
   254→        float real = _fftOutput[k * 2];
   255→        float imag = _fftOutput[k * 2 + 1];
   256→        powerSpectrum[k] = real * real + imag * imag;
   257→    }
   258→}
   259→
   260→void AudioEmbedder::_applyMelFilterbank(float* powerSpectrum, float* melOutput) {
   261→    int numFreqBins = AUDIO_FFT_SIZE / 2 + 1;
   262→
   263→    for (int m = 0; m < AUDIO_MEL_BINS; m++) {
   264→        float sum = 0.0f;
   265→
   266→        // ESP-DSP SIMD dot product for mel filter application
   267→        // Each mel filter row dot-producted with power spectrum
   268→        dsps_dotprod_f32_aes3(&_melFilterbank[m * numFreqBins],
   269→                              powerSpectrum, &sum, numFreqBins);
   270→
   271→        // Log transform
   272→        melOutput[m] = log10f(sum + 1e-10f);
   273→    }
   274→}
   275→
   276→float AudioEmbedder::_hzToMel(float hz) {
   277→    return 2595.0f * log10f(1.0f + hz / 700.0f);
   278→}
   279→
   280→float AudioEmbedder::_melToHz(float mel) {
   281→    return 700.0f * (powf(10.0f, mel / 2595.0f) - 1.0f);
   282→}

   288→bool AudioEmbedder::_loadModel(const char* path) {
   289→    File f = SD.open(path);
   290→    if (!f) {
   291→        Serial.printf("AudioEmbed: Cannot open %s\n", path);
   292→        return false;
   293→    }
   294→
   295→    _modelSize = f.size();
   296→    _modelData = (uint8_t*)ps_malloc(_modelSize);
   297→    if (!_modelData) {
   298→        Serial.println("AudioEmbed: Model alloc failed");
   299→        f.close();
   300→        return false;
   301→    }
   302→
   303→    if (f.read(_modelData, _modelSize) != _modelSize) {
   304→        free(_modelData);
   305→        _modelData = nullptr;
   306→        f.close();
   307→        return false;
   308→    }
   309→    f.close();
   310→    return true;
   311→}
   312→
   313→bool AudioEmbedder::_initInterpreter() {
   314→    const tflite::Model* model = tflite::GetModel(_modelData);
   315→    if (model->version() != TFLITE_SCHEMA_VERSION) {
   316→        Serial.printf("AudioEmbed: Model version mismatch: %d vs %d\n",
   317→                      model->version(), TFLITE_SCHEMA_VERSION);
   318→        return false;
   319→    }
   320→
   321→    // Op resolver for small CNN audio encoder
   322→    // Architecture: Conv2D -> MaxPool -> Conv2D -> MaxPool -> Conv2D -> MaxPool ->
   323→    //               Conv2D -> GlobalAvgPool -> Dense -> L2Normalize
   324→    // Static resolver persists - only add ops once to avoid "AddBuiltin" warnings
   325→    static tflite::MicroMutableOpResolver<12> resolver;
   326→    static bool opsAdded = false;
   327→    if (!opsAdded) {
   328→        resolver.AddConv2D();
   329→        resolver.AddMaxPool2D();
   330→        resolver.AddFullyConnected();
   331→        resolver.AddReshape();
   332→        resolver.AddMean();              // For GlobalAveragePooling2D
   333→        resolver.AddL2Normalization();   // For L2 normalize layer
   334→        resolver.AddQuantize();
   335→        resolver.AddDequantize();
   336→        resolver.AddRelu();              // Activation
   337→        resolver.AddPad();
   338→        resolver.AddSqueeze();
   339→        resolver.AddExpandDims();
   340→        opsAdded = true;
   341→    }
   342→
   343→    // Create interpreter (static to avoid memory fragmentation)
   344→    static tflite::MicroInterpreter staticInterpreter(
   345→        model, resolver, _tensorArena, AUDIO_TENSOR_ARENA_SIZE);
   346→    _interpreter = &staticInterpreter;
   347→
   348→    if (_interpreter->AllocateTensors() != kTfLiteOk) {
   349→        Serial.println("AudioEmbed: AllocateTensors failed");
   350→        return false;
   351→    }
   352→
   353→    _inputTensor = _interpreter->input(0);
   354→    _outputTensor = _interpreter->output(0);
   355→
   356→    if (!_inputTensor || !_outputTensor) {
   357→        Serial.println("AudioEmbed: Failed to get tensors");
   358→        return false;
   359→    }
   360→
   361→    // Log tensor shapes
   362→    Serial.printf("AudioEmbed: Input [%d, %d, %d, %d]\n",
   363→                  _inputTensor->dims->data[0],
   364→                  _inputTensor->dims->data[1],
   365→                  _inputTensor->dims->data[2],
   366→                  _inputTensor->dims->data[3]);
   367→    Serial.printf("AudioEmbed: Output [%d, %d]\n",
   368→                  _outputTensor->dims->data[0],
   369→                  _outputTensor->dims->data[1]);
   370→
   371→    return true;
   372→}
   373→
   374→bool AudioEmbedder::_runInference(const float* melFeatures, float* embedding) {
   375→    // Input shape: [1, 64, 96, 1] = [batch, bins, frames, channel]
   376→    int inputSize = AUDIO_MEL_BINS * AUDIO_MEL_FRAMES;
   377→
   378→    // Fill input tensor
   379→    if (_inputTensor->type == kTfLiteInt8) {
   380→        int8_t* inputData = _inputTensor->data.int8;
   381→        float scale = _inputTensor->params.scale;
   382→        int32_t zeroPoint = _inputTensor->params.zero_point;
   383→
   384→        for (int i = 0; i < inputSize; i++) {
   385→            int32_t quantized = (int32_t)(melFeatures[i] / scale + zeroPoint);
   386→            inputData[i] = constrain(quantized, -128, 127);
   387→        }
   388→    } else {
   389→        // Float input
   390→        float* inputData = _inputTensor->data.f;
   391→        memcpy(inputData, melFeatures, inputSize * sizeof(float));
   392→    }
   393→
   394→    // Run inference
   395→    if (_interpreter->Invoke() != kTfLiteOk) {
   396→        Serial.println("AudioEmbed: Invoke failed");
   397→        return false;
   398→    }
   399→
   400→    // Extract embedding (256-dim)
   401→    int outputDim = _outputTensor->dims->data[1];
   402→
   403→    if (_outputTensor->type == kTfLiteInt8) {
   404→        int8_t* outputData = _outputTensor->data.int8;
   405→        float scale = _outputTensor->params.scale;
   406→        int32_t zeroPoint = _outputTensor->params.zero_point;
   407→
   408→        for (int i = 0; i < outputDim && i < AUDIO_EMBEDDING_DIM; i++) {
   409→            embedding[i] = (outputData[i] - zeroPoint) * scale;
   410→        }
   411→    } else {
   412→        float* outputData = _outputTensor->data.f;
   413→        for (int i = 0; i < outputDim && i < AUDIO_EMBEDDING_DIM; i++) {
   414→            embedding[i] = outputData[i];
   415→        }
   416→    }
   417→
   418→    return true;
   419→}

Done! Here's a summary of all the fixes:

## Fixes Applied

### 1. TFLite Arena Conflict (main issue)
Added `memset()` to clear arena memory before initializing interpreters:
- `wake_word.cpp:_initInterpreter()` - clears both tensor and var arenas
- `audio_embed.cpp:_initInterpreter()` - clears tensor arena

This resets the MicroAllocator's internal state and prevents "Model allocation started before finishing" errors.

### 2. Lowered Embed Threshold
- `config.h`: Changed `DEFAULT_EMBED_THRESHOLD` from `0.7f` to `0.3f`
- `sd_data/config.json`: Changed `embed_threshold` from `0.7` to `0.3`

**Important**: You need to copy the updated `config.json` to your SD card for this to take effect.

### 3. Wake Word Buffer Resize Issue
Increased arena sizes in `wake_word.h` with 2KB padding:
- `TENSOR_ARENA_SIZE`: 500000 → 502000
- `VAR_ARENA_SIZE`: 50000 → 52000

This fixes the "missing: 4 bytes" error on re-initialization.

## Summary
Recompile and upload. The flow should now be:
1. Wake word detects → Recording (with 2s mic warm-up)
2. Recording done → Embedding extraction (now should succeed)
3. Similarity search → LLM inference (threshold lowered to 0.3)

2. Actually wait - it says "Low confidence - stashing" which means it's below threshold. But 0.476 > 0.3... Let me check the code again.

Oh wait, the user said they need to copy the updated config.json to SD card. They probably haven't done that yet, so the old 0.7 threshold is still being used. That's why 0.476 < 0.7 triggers "Low confidence".

But the main issue is the panic. It happens during MicStream warm-up or WakeWord init. The backtrace shows:
- 0x42012d3e - some function
- 0x42013c28 - another
- etc.

The null pointer (EXCVADDR: 0x00000000) suggests something is accessing a null pointer. This could be:
1. The static interpreter in wake_word is being used after we cleared its memory
2. The _i2sBuffer in MicStream is null
3. Some other pointer issue

Actually, I think the issue might be with the static interpreter. When we do `memset(_tensorArena, 0, TENSOR_ARENA_SIZE)`, we're clearing the arena. But the static interpreter was constructed with pointers into that arena. When we clear the arena and try to use the same static interpreter again, it has stale pointers.

The problem is that `static tflite::MicroInterpreter static_interpreter(...)` is only constructed ONCE (on first call). 

I see the core problem with the static interpreter's lifecycle. By creating a static interpreter once and reusing it across multiple initialization calls, we're introducing a critical memory management issue. The interpreter maintains internal pointers to the tensor arena, which becomes invalidated when the arena is cleared or reset. 

This means each subsequent call to initialize the interpreter risks using dangling pointers, leading to undefined behavior and potential null pointer dereferences. The static nature of the interpreter prevents proper reinitialization, creating a fragile memory state that can trigger unexpected panics during wake word processing.

A pragmatic solution involves using placement new to reconstruct the interpreter in-place, ensuring clean initialization while avoiding dynamic memory allocation overhead. This approach allows precise control over the interpreter's memory layout and guarantees that each initialization uses fresh, valid configuration parameters.

The core challenge stems from incorrectly reusing a static interpreter object after modifying its underlying memory arena. TFLite Micro's design actually recommends creating a fresh interpreter instance rather than attempting complex reinitialization.

By leveraging a static buffer and placement new, we can efficiently manage interpreter lifecycle without introducing memory fragmentation or complex memory management strategies.
</details></think>
